info.title: Gani Platform API — planned
info.description: Paths NOT served yet (`x-status: planned`, `x-sprint`): the contract the front end builds on until each moves to openapi.json. Same rules as openapi.json: session cookie, organisation from the session, RFC 9457 errors with a snake_case `code`.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` is the stable word (Brief P9).

get.summary: Tickets of the session’s workspaces, newest first; filter by workspace, status, assignee and conversation. Sales see the ones they made.

400.description: validation_failed: a parameter or the cursor.

403.description: forbidden: marketing and viewer; sales reads only the tickets they made; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: a workspace not among the session’s.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

post.summary: Make a ticket (Owner, Admin, Manager, Sales, Support: Phụ lục B "Ticket: tạo"), status `new`, from a conversation or not.

schema.description: A key the client makes per action (a UUID); sent again with the same request, it gets the first answer back.

parameters.description: A key the client makes per action (a UUID); sent again with the same request, it gets the first answer back.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: validation_failed: a field, or the Idempotency-Key is missing.

403.description: forbidden: marketing and viewer; sales reads only the tickets they made; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: the workspace, customer or conversation is not visible.

409.description: idempotency_in_progress: the same key is still running.

422.description: invalid_assignee: not an Owner, Admin, Manager or Support of the workspace (U52); or idempotency_key_reused.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

get.summary: One ticket with what happened to it (`events`, oldest first).

403.description: forbidden: marketing and viewer; sales reads only the tickets they made; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: no ticket with this id in the session’s workspaces (not visible is the same).

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

patch.summary: Change a ticket (Owner, Admin, Manager, Support). `status` follows new → in_progress → waiting_customer ⇄ in_progress → done (reopen: done → in_progress); `cancelled` from any open state, Owner/Admin/Manager only, and final. Waiting for the customer stops the SLA clock (U27).

400.description: validation_failed: a field, or nothing to change.

403.description: forbidden: sales, marketing, viewer; `cancelled` asked by support; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: no ticket with this id in the session’s workspaces (not visible is the same).

409.description: version_conflict: the ticket changed since it was read; or invalid_transition: this status cannot follow the current one.

422.description: invalid_assignee: not an Owner, Admin, Manager or Support of the workspace (U52).

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

get.summary: The five cards of #16 for one workspace (U29): open, waiting for an agent, first reply P90 today, over SLA, agents online / total. Sales and Support get their own figures (scope `me`, no agent cards).

404.description: not_found: a workspace not among the session’s.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

get.summary: Every flag of Đợt 1 for one workspace, on or off, and whether it is locked in this phase.

403.description: forbidden: only an Owner or an Admin (Phụ lục B "Bật/tắt AI nội bộ", "tắt feature flag"); or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: a workspace not among the session’s.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

patch.summary: Turn a flag on or off for one workspace (audited: `feature_flag.changed`). A flag locked in this phase cannot be turned on.

400.description: validation_failed: the key, the workspace id or `enabled`.

403.description: forbidden: only an Owner or an Admin (Phụ lục B "Bật/tắt AI nội bộ", "tắt feature flag"); or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: a workspace not among the session’s.

409.description: not_in_phase: this flag cannot be turned on in Đợt 1 (U29).

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

get.summary: The autonomy level of a workspace and the levels that can be chosen now (Owner, Admin).

403.description: forbidden: only an Owner or an Admin; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: a workspace not among the session’s.

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

patch.summary: Change the level with a reason (audited: `workspace.autonomy_changed`). Raising it is the Owner’s alone; lowering it, Owner or Admin (Phụ lục B).

400.description: validation_failed: the level or the reason (1–500 characters).

403.description: forbidden: an Admin raising the level, or another role; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: a workspace not among the session’s.

409.description: not_in_phase: L2 and above open in Đợt 2 (U29).

503.description: service_unavailable: the session or the membership could not be read.

post.summary: Carry out a pending request in one transaction (audited: `privacy.executed`, ids and kind only). `export` answers the customer’s data as JSON (`PrivacyExport`, served as an attachment); `erase` removes the personal data for good and answers what it removed (`PrivacyErasure`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: The export (kind `export`) or what was erased (kind `erase`).

403.description: forbidden: only an Owner or an Admin; or a refusal of the edge.

404.description: not_found: no such request in the organisation.
